new admissions overnight and who is waiting for a bed
the dose waves, the ward round and the theatre list

moments.label: Shift handover
moments.caption: The night nurse hands over to the day team at the nurse hub, then at each bedside.

moments.label: Breakfast
moments.caption: Trays go out by MealBot, and the host takes each one into the room.

moments.label: Robotic surgery
moments.caption: On level 2 the da Vinci robot is docked and the surgeon is at the console for the first case.

moments.label: Ward rounds
moments.caption: The doctor does the day's one ward round with the nurse, a bed at a time, and signs planned discharges.

moments.label: Discharges
moments.caption: Patients go home with their families, and their rooms are cleaned for the next person.

moments.label: Lunch and the midday dose wave
moments.caption: Lunch goes out, and the midday medicines follow close behind.

moments.label: Visiting
moments.caption: Families arrive in the afternoon, and the lobby fills up.

moments.label: Dinner
moments.caption: The last meal of the day, then the evening medicines.

moments.label: Evening handover
moments.caption: The day team hands over to the night team, ward by ward.

moments.label: Night
moments.caption: Lights dim, one night nurse per ward looks in on every room from 22:30, and the ER runs at night rates.
